primary_original.author: William Lilly
primary_original.title: Christian Astrology
primary_original.edition: London 1647 first printing; original digitized Wellcome copy
primary_original.read_mode: Original first-edition page images directly visually inspected; p104 table 12 signs and all face/term columns newly transcribed; not a complete textual criticism of all historical prints

direct_original_rule_claims.qualification: Lilly's numerical table is explicitly source-defined for essential dignity only; accidental fortification, angularity, aspecting, planetary condition not computed here.

direct_original_rule_claims.value: Printed 1647 table headed A Table of the Essentiall Dignities of the Planets according to Ptolomy. Exact twelve sign rows and decans encoded in script. Endpoints are original printed cumulative degree term ends.
direct_original_rule_claims.qualification: This printed first edition's terms disagree in some signs with Robbins 1940 Ptolemaic terms and Egyptian terms, neither automatically supersedes the other; no silent correction.

direct_original_rule_claims.value: Sun day fire triplicity vs Jupiter night; Venus day earth vs Moon night; Saturn day air vs Mercury night; Mars always water. If unknown solar altitude near horizon, abstain.
direct_original_rule_claims.qualification: Lilly's original sector readings are part of essential dignity points. Sunrise/sunset ±0.1 degree is an engineering uncertainty, not Lilly-authored orb.

direct_original_rule_claims.value: Lilly explicitly presents rival ancient criteria, states his preference for combined essential and accidental strengths and angularity, and reports Greek custom of selecting a planet with most dignities at the Moon and Mercury places.
direct_original_rule_claims.qualification: This is a reported Greek custom within Lilly, not a proof Ptolemy advocated exactly a 5+4+3+2+1 sum or that this alone determines the ruler of the geniture.

direct_original_rule_claims.value: After earlier conditions, the planet with most essential dignities in the places of Mercury and Moon is considered a manners significator.
direct_original_rule_claims.qualification: Earlier ASC sign/intercepted, joined Moon or Mercury, dispositor and other planets' aspects, partile force must be preserved; whether points at both places are summed or maximum used is unspecified. Strength and tie-breaking also open.

historical_limits: Term variant differences are edition-specific, not proof Lilly printed term table more accurate than Ptolemy's own term source.
First 1647 original term boundaries may contain printing anomalies; future critical editions might correct them but cannot silently change this witness.
Other Ptolemaic fifth mode phase/aspect, lunar application/separation and contrary testimonies not resolved.
Only last-stage essential dignity possibilities processed; S1-S4 and SX are not final personality rulers.
Lilly p531-532 explicitly distinguishes his favored broad geniture ruler, accidental dignity and alternative Greek rule.
No natal outcome independent matching, no trait accuracy, no participant questionnaire used, and no unique natal ranking.
